resources.string: Android System WebView needs an update
Module Library draws its Setup page with Android System WebView, and this version (%1$s) lacks what it needs. Update Android System WebView from the Play Store, then open Module Library again.
Android System WebView is out of date
Foundry VTT 14 needs Android System WebView %1$d or newer; this phone has %2$s. Foundry may warn about it or misbehave until you update it from the Play Store.

The server at %1$s uses a certificate this phone doesn\'t trust, often a self-signed one. Module Library doesn\'t open such servers yet: use the server\'s plain http address on your home network, or give it a certificate from a public authority.
